validation_results.failure: Rock Tunnel produced a fifth persistent paralysis after the four-item reserve had been consumed.

diagnosis: The route had a deterministic four-cure inventory but no per-battle spending limit. A fresh status lineage could repeatedly re-paralyze the active battler and exhaust cures before a later move-evidence gate.
repair_direction: Use the remaining guaranteed-income margin to carry seven Parlyz Heals, preserve the qualified post-purchase RNG residue, and cap in-battle Parlyz Heal use at one per trainer while continuing to replan attacks under repeated paralysis.
